description: Line budgets for each module of apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/, recorded at the post-split sizes and checked by scripts/check_flow_module_budgets.py (run by 'uv run task lint'). A module may shrink but never grow past its budget. Budgets of child_progress.py, stages/calibrate.py and stages/intent.py were raised by 1, 1 and 3 lines for the ref_names helpers that build and name the /_ and /calibrated branches. Budgets of stages/intent.py, stages/plan.py, stages/execute.py, review/resolver.py and git_refs.py were also raised for the host-side fetch and push that moved every remote operation of a stage out of the role containers (host_remote.py owns them). Budgets of stages/decomposition.py and stages/children.py were raised by 4 and 2 lines to report a child branch name that cannot fit as a Stage 3 failure and to record original_slug on shortened child intents. The budget of review/loop.py was raised by 3 lines so the reviewed-commit lookup skips the fetch in a mounted role container (the host fetches before dispatch) and imports the one shared mounted-workspace check. The budget of git_refs.py was raised by 21 lines (the last one so the unfetched-branch message takes an optional role label and review_target reuses it) so the execution-diff check skips the fetch in a mounted role container (the host fetches before dispatch) and names a branch the host did not fetch. The budget of stages/calibrate.py was raised by 7 lines for the hook of the final-head CI check (github/ci_final_head.py owns the logic). The budgets of __init__.py and github/ci_wait.py were raised by 2 lines each: __init__.py to import and export format_final_head_ci, and ci_wait.py for the stop_on_failure parameter of wait_for_pending_ci that lets the final-head check keep waiting while a check has failed. The budget of stages/execute.py was raised by 4 lines for the call to partial_salvage.py, which commits an interrupted run's leftovers on a Stage 3 resume. The budget of __init__.py was raised by 12 lines to import and export the partial_salvage.py names. The budget of __init__.py was raised by 2 lines to re-export build_review_id from the new review/ids.py module, as the package export test requires, and the budget of review/loop.py by 1 more line to keep the summary-record comment above the new review id call. The budget of stages/plan.py was raised by 5 lines to import the shared PLAN_FILE_PATTERN from entrypoint/planner.py (wrapped import) so the plan-stage validator and the planner share one plan-file regex. The budget of stages/plan_decision.py was raised by 1 line to import the same constant for its back-fill path-shape check. The budget of stages/execute.py was raised by 5 lines for the call to stages/sync_conflict.py, which reports a non-ledger pre-push sync conflict as a resumable Stage 3 result. The budget of __init__.py was raised by 2 lines to import and export sync_conflict_result from the new stages/sync_conflict.py. The budgets of stages/calibrate.py and stages/review.py were raised by 14 and 2 lines for the Stage 5 sync and restore hooks (calibrate_sync.py owns the logic). The budget of calibrate_sync.py was raised by 4 lines so record_starting_branch takes the calling stage's git runner, which keeps a stage whose tests replace its runner from spawning a real git process. The budgets of calibrate_sync.py, stages/calibrate.py and pipeline.py were raised by 2, 3 and 8 lines so a stale /calibrated branch fails Stage 5 and the pipeline restores the starting branch on every exit. The budgets of review/loop.py and review/resolver.py were raised by 3 and 11 lines to carry the rejected-attempt fields to the ledger row that review/rejected_attempt_record.py writes. The budgets of review/loop.py and stages/calibrate.py were raised by 4 and 5 lines for the call sites of the timing-gate finding (review/ci_timing_finding.py) and the Stage 5 re-verification (github/ci_reverify.py), which own the logic. The budgets of review/loop.py and review/posting.py were raised by 3 and 16 lines so a halt that lands on the last label (a failed verdict from a crashed, timed-out or stalled reviewer turn, a budget stop, an unresolved ref or unmeasured tests) keeps the report local and the summary row records why (review/posting.py owns the rule). The budget of __init__.py was raised by 2 lines to re-export is_terminal_verdict, the public posting.py helper review/loop.py calls, as the package export test requires. The budgets of review/loop.py and stages/calibrate.py were raised by 4 and 5 lines for the call sites of the timing-gate finding (review/ci_timing_finding.py) and the Stage 5 re-verification (github/ci_reverify.py), which own the logic. calibrate_rebuild.py was added at creation size to rebuild the flow's own stale /calibrated branch (it now also owns CalibrationSyncError, re-exported by calibrate_sync.py), and the budget of calibrate_sync.py was raised by 6 lines to call it from prepare_calibrated_branch. The budget of stages/calibrate.py was raised by 4 lines to record the calibrated_head (the execution head the calibration report covers) in the Stage 5 payload and completion log. The budget of __init__.py was raised by 10 lines to import and export the public calibrate_rebuild.py names, as the package export test requires. The budget of calibrate_sync.py was raised by 1 line so a stale local /calibrated is re-pointed at a current origin /calibrated rather than the execution head, keeping the later push a fast-forward. Lower a budget by hand after shrinking a module; add an entry at creation size for a new module and remove the entry of a deleted one.
